title: The minimum degree question for the Maker Breaker Domination Game
summary: The Maker Breaker Domination Game is a two player game played on a graph $G$ in which the players take turns to claim a vertex from the graph. The aim of the Dominator is to claim the vertices of a dominating set, and the aim of the Staller is to prevent this. In this paper, we consider the following problem: for a given integer $d$, what is the size of the smallest (with respect to the number of vertices) graph with minimum degree $d$ such that the Dominator loses going first? We write $β(d)$ to denote the answer to this question. We determine the precise value of $β(d)$ for $d\leq 3$. For…
